mapper.sql: SELECT m.id, m.filename, m.original_filename, m.file_path, m.video_mp4_path, m.file_size, m.file_type, m.media_type, m.title, m.description, m.user_id, m.cover_image, m.duration, m.view_count, m.is_favorite, m.is_deleted, m.is_public, m.deleted_at, m.created_at, m.updated_at, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.description AS cat_description, c.created_at AS cat_created_at, c.updated_at AS cat_updated_at, a.id AS alb_id, a.name AS alb_name, a.description AS alb_description, a.cover_image AS alb_cover_image, a.media_count AS alb_media_count, a.user_id AS alb_user_id, a.created_at AS alb_created_at, a.updated_at AS alb_updated_at, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.created_at AS tag_created_at, t.updated_at AS tag_updated_at FROM media m LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN albums a ON a.id = m.album_id LEFT JOIN media_tag mt ON mt.media_id = m.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = mt.tag_id
mapper.select: WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = #{isDeleted} ORDER BY m.id
WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_favorite = #{isFavorite} ORDER BY m.id
WHERE m.album_id = #{albumId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id
WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.category_id = #{categoryId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.id
WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_tag mt2 WHERE mt2.media_id = m.id AND mt2.tag_id = #{tagId}) ORDER BY m.id
WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.media_type = #{mediaType} AND m.is_deleted = #{isDeleted} ORDER BY m.id

INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, CASE WHEN title = #{keyword} THEN 0 WHEN original_filename = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN title LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN original_filename LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN filename LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 4 WHEN title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 5 WHEN original_filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 6 WHEN filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 7 WHEN description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 8 ELSE 9 END AS relevance FROM media m2 WHERE m2.user_id = #{userId} AND m2.is_deleted = FALSE AND (m2.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m2.original_filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m2.filename LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m2.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ) AS hit ON hit.id = m.id ORDER BY hit.relevance, m.id

choose.when: ORDER BY m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC
ORDER BY m.title ASC, m.id ASC
ORDER BY m.file_size DESC, m.id ASC
ORDER BY m.media_type ASC, m.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media (filename, original_filename, file_path, video_mp4_path, file_size, file_type, media_type, title, description, category_id, album_id, user_id, cover_image, duration, view_count, is_favorite, is_deleted, is_public, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{filename}, #{originalFilename}, #{filePath}, #{videoMp4Path}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{mediaType}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category.id}, #{album.id}, #{userId}, #{coverImage}, #{duration}, #{viewCount}, #{isFavorite}, #{isDeleted}, #{isPublic}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: WHERE m.is_deleted = TRUE AND m.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND m.deleted_at < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media m WHERE m.is_public = TRUE AND m.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE m.album_id = #{albumId} AND m.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.id

SELECT m.id, m.filename, m.original_filename, m.file_path, m.video_mp4_path, m.file_size, m.file_type, m.media_type, m.title, m.description, m.user_id, m.cover_image, m.duration, m.view_count, m.is_favorite, m.is_deleted, m.is_public, m.deleted_at, m.created_at, m.updated_at, u.username AS author_name, u.avatar AS author_avatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_likes ml WHERE ml.media_id = m.id) AS like_count, c.id AS cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, c.description AS cat_description, c.created_at AS cat_created_at, c.updated_at AS cat_updated_at, a.id AS alb_id, a.name AS alb_name, a.description AS alb_description, a.cover_image AS alb_cover_image, a.media_count AS alb_media_count, a.user_id AS alb_user_id, a.created_at AS alb_created_at, a.updated_at AS alb_updated_at, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.created_at AS tag_created_at, t.updated_at AS tag_updated_at FROM media m JOIN ( SELECT id FROM media WHERE is_public = TRUE AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit} ) r ON r.id = m.id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN albums a ON a.id = m.album_id LEFT JOIN media_tag mt ON mt.media_id = m.id LEFT JOIN tag t ON t.id = mt.tag_id
